fields.description: The company's name that customers see.
fields.label: Company Name

fields.description: The full name of the partner's Owner. Set from the Owner in the team, so it changes when the Owner changes.
fields.label: Partner Name

fields.description: Square brand mark (logomark) used where the full logo is too small to read — e.g. the 40px avatar in list views. Falls back to `logo`, then to the partner's initial.
fields.label: Logo Icon

fields.description: CSS background-position X, as a percent — lets a partner drag their logo to reframe it instead of always showing it centered.
fields.label: Logo Position X

fields.description: CSS background-position Y, as a percent.
fields.label: Logo Position Y

fields.description: Set by Frappe admins only — partners cannot self-edit their tier.
fields.label: Tier

fields.description: Set by Frappe admins only — partners cannot self-edit their verification status.
fields.label: Verification Status

fields.description: Pending while the partner's admin picks their Frappe Cloud team. Completed once Frappe Cloud knows the team, so hires can be linked there.
fields.label: Frappe Cloud Registration

fields.description: When the admin was last emailed the registration link. A new link replaces the old one, so Connect sends one only after the old one expires.
fields.label: Frappe Cloud Registration Sent On

fields.description: The partner's main email for Frappe. Frappe Cloud marks the invoices of the partner's customers with it, so Connect finds the partner's revenue by it.
fields.label: Email

fields.description: The partner's contact email from frappe.io. Not shown on the public profile.
fields.label: Contact Email

fields.description: Drives the "Frappe Specialist" crown badge. Set by Frappe admins only — partners cannot self-edit this.
fields.label: Frappe Specialist

fields.description: Precomputed average of reviews.rating
fields.label: Rating

fields.description: The partner's currency. Their hourly rate, quotes and tier revenue targets are in it. Set from the country when empty: India uses INR, every other country USD.
fields.label: Currency

fields.description: The daily tier review leaves this partner's tier as it is. Use it for a tier agreed outside the rules, such as a legacy contract.
fields.label: Keep Tier

fields.description: Why the tier is kept, so anyone opening the partner knows.
fields.label: Keep Tier Reason

fields.description: Revenue from this partner's Frappe Cloud customers last month. The daily tier review sets it.
fields.label: Revenue Last Month

fields.description: Revenue so far this month. The daily tier review sets it.
fields.label: Revenue This Month

fields.description: When the revenue above was last read from Frappe Cloud. Empty means it never was: the partner has no email.
fields.label: Revenue Updated On

fields.description: The tier last month's revenue, certificates and PMM level earn, from the latest daily review. The tier changes to it only when Apply Tier Changes is on in Integration Settings and Keep Tier is off.
fields.label: Tier From Last Review

fields.description: The tier this month's revenue would give if the month ended today.
fields.label: Tier This Month Points To

fields.description: The day the partner was last turned on for the website. A partner short of certificates is only taken off after 90 days.
fields.label: Listed On

fields.description: Show if the partner has the certificates its tier needs (or is still within 90 days of being listed), Hide if not, from the latest daily review. Show in Website follows it only when Apply Tier and Listing Changes is on in Integration Settings and Keep Listing As Is is off.
fields.label: Listing From Last Review

fields.description: The daily review leaves Show in Website as it is. Use it when staff list or hide a partner by hand on purpose.
fields.label: Keep Listing As Is

fields.description: Why the listing is kept, so anyone opening the partner knows.
fields.label: Keep Listing Reason

fields.description: Copied from frappe.io. Frappe Cloud will update it when the partner renews.
fields.label: Contract Start Date

fields.description: Copied from frappe.io. Connect does not disable a partner after this date yet.
fields.label: Contract End Date
Contract End Date as per Payment

fields.description: The partner is on an older contract. frappe.io's daily tier review skips these partners.
fields.label: Apply Legacy Contract

fields.description: Podcasts, stories, videos and posts by Frappe about this partner, in the order the profile shows them. Partners can't change these.
fields.label: Featured by Frappe

fields.description: Frappe staff who look after this partner. The partner's team sees them in Connect's company menu and can email them.
fields.label: Partner Managers

fields.description: The partner's own account of how the firm began and what shaped it. Shown at the end of their profile; the Description is shown there when this is empty.
fields.label: How They Got Started

fields.description: Set on save from the Region that lists the partner's country.
fields.label: Region

fields.description: Shown on the public profile. Up to 5.
fields.label: Offices

fields.description: The path of this partner's old page on frappe.io, for example partners/india/acme. Set by the frappe.io import, so old links can open this partner in Connect.
fields.label: frappe.io Page

fields.description: Up to 6. An industry with 2 or more success stories shows a verified tick.
fields.label: Industries

fields.description: From the frappe.io import. Partners cannot change it.
fields.label: Successful Projects Count

fields.description: Set by Frappe admins only — partners cannot self-edit this.
fields.label: PMM Level

fields.description: This partner's page on frappe.io/partners. PMM Level is synced from it.
fields.label: PMM Listing URL

fields.description: In the partner's currency. Leave blank if not disclosed.
fields.label: Hourly Rate

fields.description: From the frappe.io import. Partners cannot change it.
fields.label: Total Sites Count

fields.description: From the frappe.io import. Partners cannot change it.
fields.label: Number of Certified Members

fields.description: Counted from this partner's linked, unexpired certificates.
fields.label: ERPNext Certifications

fields.description: Counted from this partner's linked, unexpired certificates.
fields.label: Frappe Framework Certifications

fields.description: Free Frappe School certifications Frappe gives this partner once their partnership is approved. Set by Frappe; partners can't change it.
fields.label: Free Certifications

fields.description: Counted from Countries Served.
fields.label: Number of Countries Served

fields.description: Countries the partner works in. Shown on the profile, and searchable with the served_country filter.
fields.label: Countries Served

fields.description: Set by Frappe, not the partner. Approved to be assigned Starter Pack orders; every approved partner delivers all four packs.
fields.label: Starter Pack Partner

fields.description: Position in the round robin that hands out paid Starter Pack orders. Filled in automatically when a partner is approved (they join the end of the line) and must be unique.
fields.label: Starter Pack Rotation Order

fields.description: From the frappe.io import. Partners cannot change it.
fields.label: References Available

fields.description: Only relevant when "Offers Starter Pack" is checked.
fields.label: Starter Pack

fields.description: Precomputed averages recalculated in Partner.before_save from the matching per-dimension fields on each Partner Review row. A dimension is skipped for rows that left it blank.
fields.label: Rating Breakdown

fields.description: The apps the partner's success stories name. Filled automatically on save.
fields.label: Apps

fields.description: Distinct from Success Stories — shown in the profile's own "Partner stories" section rather than reused from Success Stories.
fields.label: Partner Stories

fields.description: The person quoted, usually someone at a customer of this partner.
fields.label: Name of person

fields.description: The company the quoted person works for.
fields.label: Company name
How We Define a Successful Implementation

fields.description: Free-form list of demo names/links, one per line.
fields.label: Demos

fields.description: Shows the partner in the directory, search and partner finder. The profile still opens from a direct link.
fields.label: Show in Website

fields.description: This partner's CRM Partner on Frappe's sales CRM. Connect keeps its tier, status, email, name and country up to date.
fields.label: CRM Partner

fields.description: Listing changes the partner admin saved but hasn't published yet. Publish copies them to the profile.
fields.label: Unpublished Profile Changes
